SourcesBox score, game stories and the drawn play

Box score from the Heat's 133–121 win over the Cleveland Cavaliers at Kaseya Center on Nov 13, 2026 (NBA Cup, East Group B), from the Covers box score, with the main lines matched by Yardbarker, the Associated Press (via Cleveland 19 and ABC News) and Field Level Media. All 133 Miami points and all 121 Cleveland points are accounted for in the Covers box score, and the quarter scores (29–25–38–41 to 27–30–34–30) add up to both totals. The half was 57–54 Cleveland on James Harden's buzzer three (Field Level Media, Covers; the Sun Sentinel has 57–55) and 92–91 Miami after three. Biggest leads (Miami 13, Cleveland 6) and team totals are from Covers. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Friday's games.

Adebayo and Antetokounmpo are the second Heat pair to score 37 in the same game, after LeBron James and Dwyane Wade in 2013 (AP). Miami opened the fourth on a 13–2 run, with Adebayo scoring the Heat's first 10 points of the quarter (Field Level Media); he scored 18 in the fourth (Field Level Media). Davion Mitchell's 17 assists tied his career high (AP). Miami won its third straight and is 2–0 in group play, alone atop East Group B (AP). Miami was without Klay Thompson and Pelle Larsson; Cleveland was without Evan Mobley and Sam Merrill (AP, Field Level Media). Miami hosts Detroit on Saturday at 8:00 PM ET (AP, Miami Herald).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Davion Mitchell's 3-pointer with 6:46 to play that pushed Miami's lead from 107–97 to 110–97 (Sun Sentinel, via Yahoo Sports); 13 points was Miami's biggest lead of the night (Covers). The move isn't described further, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Davion Mitchell's listed 6-foot-0 and 202 pounds (RealGM), in Miami's home white with No. 45 (RealGM). No wingspan from a named source was found, so his arms are drawn to his height. He has no approved look on file yet, so he is drawn in the kit with our default skin tone. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
